claims.statement: The tested Orbtronic 18650PD 2900mAh sample was a black button-top cell measuring approximately 18.5 mm x 66.5 mm; the report identifies a Panasonic PF cell inside and does not describe a protection circuit.
Steam Engine preserves Orbtronic 18650 PD2900 2900mAh 10A as a 2900mAh preset with a 10A runtime rating.

The Orbtronic 18650 PD2900 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Orbtronic 18650 PD2900 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-12-08 or earlier.
